title: Why does the scale jump after a cheat meal? ⚖️
caption:
Carbs are stored as glycogen with about 3 g of water per gram, salt holds more water, and the food is still in your gut. One kilo of fat needs about 7,700 extra calories. Watch your weekly average, not one morning. Biggest jump you have seen? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #18
first_comment: +2 kg after one pizza night. Who else panicked? 🍕😂
